dz: 在推翻马里尼德王朝的1465年摩洛哥革命中,犹太人的弥勒被费斯人所攻击,尽管屠杀的程度受到争论.
de: During the 1465 Moroccan revolution which overthrows the Marinid dynasty, the Jewish mellah is attacked by the population of Fez, though the extent of the massacre is debated.
